audit_scope.archive_byte_status_meaning: Only a non-null archive SHA256 plus an explicit source says archive bytes were verified. Tag-source characterization never implies an archive was found.
audit_scope.native_status_meaning: Exact native evidence only. not_run is retained rather than inferred.

published_mir4_release_origin_inventory.prior_mir4_release_origin_enumeration: pending; this bounded unit must not be read as a complete MIR4 release or archive-variant inventory

current.role: finite-cap state and direct F200 legacy-cap import

earliest_direct_f200_tag_1_0_0.state_obligation_disposition: No control.lua exists in the 1.0.0 tag tree. Absent migration Lua is not proof that a source save has no obligation; preserve data-stage identities and require native source-save evidence.

intermediate_1_to_3_runtime_schema_evolu.scope: This unit records each tag's info.json and migration-member bodies, not a completed control.lua/runtime-state evolution audit for every intermediate 1.x-3.x tag.

package_support.rule: Lua members are selectable package members; JSON migration members are additionally selected only from the migrations directory.

migration_member_audit.retention_decision: Retain every published migration filename/body history. Missing Lua migration members do not prove the corresponding historical runtime state has no obligation; source_state_producer_boundaries names the current and MIR4 runtime-ledger/carrier owners to inspect before source-save creation.

metadata_source.statement: Archive records come from retained release metadata and SHA256SUMS evidence. A local direct-library absence is not an invented archive absence.

direct_f200_and_f210_tag_origins.policy: One protected source save per exact archive when available; direct F200/F210 execution is required before a later 5.x acceptance claim.

published_4_7_3_origins.policy: Each supported F013/F014/F015/F016/F017/F100/F110/F200/F210 source needs a 4.7.3-to-5.0.0 route appropriate to its engine bridge; do not claim an F018 source that was never published in this baseline.

older_engine_origins.policy: Visible best-effort engine-bridge population; never silently exclude it and never mislabel it as direct F200/F210.

future_5_x_upgrade_cadence.policy: Test a protected accepted 5.0.0 save against each later accepted 5.x package with exact package/archive and engine pins; this inventory is not evidence that a future build passed.

known_gaps_and_retention: All 64 versioned 1.x-3.x tag source trees are characterized, but no historical archive SHA256 is invented where a byte-verified published ZIP has not been located.
Exact 1.0.0 is F200-direct by its info.json factorio_version 2.0 and must not be moved into the older-engine bridge population.
The 25 non-F200/F210 tag origins remain explicit best-effort bridge cases. Existing F017/F100/F110 evidence is useful only at its recorded exact inputs.
Existing MIR4 source and cross-engine chains are retained as scoped reuse candidates, not relabelled as current 5.x acceptance.
Only v4.7.3 is enumerated in published_mir4_release_origin_inventory. Earlier MIR4 releases and their archive variants remain a visible pending inventory task.
Intermediate 1.x-3.x control.lua/runtime schema evolution is not inferred from the absence of migration Lua and remains pending source-boundary audit.
No fixture, save, profile, package, direct library, engine, or artifact is changed by this inventory.
